input_ref: Pharmacy advocate: can i quote a copay before i verify the member

output.reason: None of the units says whether a copay may be quoted before verification. U-RX-EDU-001-04 covers how to verify a member but not when verification must happen relative to quoting. U-RX-EDU-001-06 covers callbacks when verification fails. U-RX-EDU-002-08 covers how to describe a quoted estimate, not its timing.
